description: Component registry for the Malaria Detection capstone project. Defines the four instrumented component types across Milestone_Report.html, Final_Report.html, and Presentation_Slides.html. Consumed at runtime by analytics-core.js for action-map building.

components.description: Fixed side navigation with section labels and dot indicators. Dynamically built at runtime from data-nav-label attributes. Persists across the session. One per report page.

events.description: Fires once per session when the nav first enters the viewport at 50% threshold.
Fires when the reader clicks a section or subsection link in the side nav.

components.description: A top-level or model-level report section (e.g. Problem Definition, CNN1 Baseline). Also used for individual slides in Presentation_Slides.html. Use data-component-instance for the section or slide ID.

events.description: Fires when the section scrolls into the viewport. Impression rate reveals how far readers progress through the document.
Fires on any click interaction within the section body.

components.description: A figure or chart block containing an image and caption. Used for training curves, confusion matrices, ROC curves, EDA plots, and triage charts. Use data-component-instance for the figure slug (e.g. confusion-roc-cnn3).

events.description: Fires when the figure enters the viewport. Impression rate across figure instances shows which charts readers actually reached.
Fires when the reader clicks on a figure (zoom-in interaction).

components.description: A row of KPI metric boxes for a single model (recall, accuracy, AUC, FN count). Use data-component-instance for the model slug (e.g. cnn3, mobilenetv2, comparison).

events.description: Fires when the metric row enters the viewport. Impression rate across model instances reveals which model results readers examined.
Fires when the reader clicks on a metric row or individual metric box.
